page_title: WHU 1-1 MCI | West Ham v Manchester City 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mads Hermansen, who smothers the ball.
90+6' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) is coming onto the pitch as Jarrod Bowen cannot continue after picking up an injury.

90+5' The ball from the resulting corner kick slipped through the box to Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City), who instantly fires a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is blocked. So unlucky. The ball rebounds to Marc Guehi (Manchester City) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
90+5' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) will deliver the corner kick.

90+4' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Adama Traore (West Ham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mads Hermansen intercepts the ball.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+1' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
89' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
88' The current number of corner kicks is 1:13. Fouls committed – 12:5.
87' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
84' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
84' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

83' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) takes a mid-range free kick, but Mads Hermansen stops the ball from reaching the top of the net by tipping it onto the crossbar. Great save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
83' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester City.
82' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

78' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Mads Hermansen with a brilliant diving save!
78' Corner kick. Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) is ready to send the ball into the box.
77' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
76' The referee is firm and issues Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) a deserved yellow card.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) replaces Bernardo Silva.
75' Pepijn Lijnders has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Phil Foden (Manchester City) replacing Antoine Semenyo.
75' Taty Castellanos comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adama Traore (West Ham).
73' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
73' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
72' Rodri (Manchester City) sends a long cross over to Matheus Nunes, but Mads Hermansen comes forward to gather the ball.
70' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
69' The total number of attempts is 1:13. 1:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
68' Bernardo Silva floats over the corner and Marc Guehi (Manchester City) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post.
68' The referee awards a corner and Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) goes over to take it.

67' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Mads Hermansen pulls off a brilliant save. Manchester City will take a corner kick.

66' Rodri (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. A rebound falls kindly for Jeremy Doku (Manchester City), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
65' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham).
63' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) attacks the corner from Bernardo Silva in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
63' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

63' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
62' The resulting corner from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
61' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.

61' A pass into the box finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Mads Hermansen denies him. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
60' Pepijn Lijnders decides to make a substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri will be replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
60' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Omar Marmoush.
59' It could have been a good chance to score! Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) fails to release Erling Haaland with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
57' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
56' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
55' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but Mads Hermansen comes off his line to gather the ball.
55' Foul! Axel Disasi (West Ham) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
54' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
54' A pass by Rodri (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Omar Marmoush, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
50' Rodri (Manchester City) plays a long ball to Erling Haaland, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
48' A precise short pass from Bernardo Silva releases Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
45+2' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Erling Haaland. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post.
44' Pablo (West Ham) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Jarrod Bowen, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
43' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) plays a terrific long ball forward to Taty Castellanos, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
39' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham).
37' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
35' 1 - 1 Jarrod Bowen delivers a well-placed cross from the corner. Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) wins the ball and powers an unstoppable header in off the crossbar. The score now reads 1:1.
35' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

34' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. West Ham force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! Omar Marmoush found Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Mads Hermansen off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
31' Total attempts – 0:3. 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
30' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
27' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) darts into the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball in from Rayan Ait-Nouri, but the ball just glances off his head and flies well wide of the right post.
27' Nico O'Reilly received a sweet pass from Rodri (Manchester City), but the advance is stopped.
26' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
24' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham). Michael Oliver saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
23' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
22' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the resulting free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
18' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

18' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
16' The possession of the ball – 14:86.
11' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
10' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

10' Erling Haaland latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) and heads towards goal. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
8' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
8' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared.
4' The corner from Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is intercepted by the defence.
4' The corner kick from Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
4' The ball is cleared after Rodri (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Manchester City force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
